# Sleep Tracker — Pixel Bar Chart

A simple offline browser app to track hours slept per night for 7 days and visualize them as a pixel-style bar chart.

## Features

- 7 number inputs (one per day) constrained to 0–12 hours.
- Pixel-style bar chart with proportional heights.
- Weekly average displayed to one decimal place.
- Longest night highlighted in gold.
- Keyboard accessible with labeled controls.
- Responsive layout down to 360px width.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Adjust the input values to update the chart and statistics in real time.

No network requests, external assets, or build steps are required.

## Files

- `index.html` — structure and controls
- `styles.css` — theme, layout, and pixel styling
- `script.js` — data handling, chart rendering, and statistics
